purpose: Hard source-of-truth lock for OpsOh App Store bundle URLs. Any future build must preserve these exact URLs for bundle App Store badges and bundle data.
rules: Bundle App Store badges must point to apps.apple.com/us/app-bundle URLs.
Bundle App Store badges must never point to individual app URLs.
Do not use older itunes.apple.com redirects in the website.
Do not infer missing bundle URLs; ask the user.
If any bundle badge URL is not one of these four locked URLs, the build is not publish-safe.
